headline: Start with three manually reviewed seed posts, then mark each one with accountId.

gate.title: Seed the feedback loop
gate.headline: Start with a tiny manually reviewed batch before scaling.
nextActions: Mark each post with accountId immediately.
Wait for X Analytics, then import impressions and engagement.

workflow.title: Post tiny seed batch
workflow.detail: Use at most three fresh, low-risk posts and confirm each manually.

workflow.title: Mark posted with accountId
workflow.detail: Use the Dashboard button so account routing and cooldown records stay linked.

workflow.title: Paste X Analytics
workflow.detail: Import impressions, likes, bookmarks, replies, reposts, clicks, and profile visits.

workflow.title: Compare account and angle
workflow.detail: Use measured winners before repeating an angle or scaling account volume.

workflow.title: Promote winners
workflow.detail: Move proven tools into thread, review page, or affiliate research queues.

nextActions: Post only the seed test items shown below.
Use the publish confirmation dialog or Mark posted button so accountId is saved.
Do not expand beyond the gate until X Analytics is imported.

seedTests.toolName: Mistral is rumored to be raising €3B at €20B valuation
seedTests.copyText: Worth watching: Mistral is rumored to be raising €3B at €20B valuation. I would not treat it as a tool review. The useful angle is what it says about solo operators. https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/12/mistral-is-rumored-to-be-raising-e3b-at-e20-valuation/
seedTests.reason: Fresh TechCrunch AI feed routed to AI Founder Signals; score 25, risk 0.
